court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
trial_court: Principle Judge, Family Court, Lucknow in Regular Suit No. 1268 of 2012 (Aayush Rastogi Vs. Smt. Malvika Rastogi)
case_name: Aayush Rastogi vs Principal Judge Family Court Lucknow

parties.respondent_defendant: Principal Judge Family Court Lucknow and Smt. Malvika Rastogi — wife

facts_of_case: Marriage between Aayush and Smt. Malvika was solemnized on 11.12.2011. After marriage, it was revealed that Smt. Malvika's previous marriage was not with her consent. She attempted suicide on 29.02.2012. Appellant filed a petition under Section-12 of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 and respondent filed written statement. Trial court dismissed the divorce petition.

legal_principles.principle: A person who is mentally not sound, although not an idiot or lunatic, is disqualified from contracting a valid marriage.
legal_principles.held: a clear intention of the legislature that a person who is mentally not sound although he may not be an idiot or lunatic, is disqualified from contracting a valid marriage
cited_cases: Alka w/o Abhinesh Sharma Vs. Abhinesh Chandra Sharma, (1991) AIR MP 205

legal_principles.principle: The degree of mental illness for grant of a decree of divorce may not be the same as for grant of nullity.
legal_principles.held: the degree of mental illness for grant of a decree of divorce may not be the same for grant of degree of nullity
cited_cases: Alka w/o Abhinesh Sharma Vs. Abhinesh Chandra Sharma, (1991) AIR MP 205

legal_principles.principle: A party cannot be compelled to suffer marital life with a marriage partner who is not mentally sound and is only fit for procreation of children.
legal_principles.held: a party can not be compelled to suffer marital life with a marriage partner who is not mentally sound and is only fit for procreation of children
cited_cases: Alka w/o Abhinesh Sharma Vs. Abhinesh Chandra Sharma, (1991) AIR MP 205

legal_principles.principle: What is fraud within the meaning of Section 12(1)(c) of the Act has been the subject-matter of a number of decisions.
legal_principles.held: what is fraud within the meaning of Section 12(1)(c) of the Act has been the subject-matter of a number of decisions
cited_cases: Smt. Urmila Devi Vs. Narinder Singh, (2007) AIR HP 19

keywords: Aayush Rastogi Vs. Smt. Malvika Rastogi
